request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:FIGHTER

layers.text: Recolour only the orange parts: the orange cap, the two orange chest straps and the orange loincloth become dull brown leather, the brown of milk chocolate, shaded dark brown; there is no orange and no red left on him. Do not touch his skin, face or ears. Keep everything else exactly the same: the olive green skin, the grey belt and wrist bands, dagger, eyes, teeth, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style, on a transparent background.
